paragraphs.en: The next planet was inhabited by a tippler. The visit was brief but left the little prince feeling deeply sad.
paragraphs.zh: 下一个星球住着一个嗜酒者。这次访问虽然短暂，却让小王子感到异常悲伤。

paragraphs.en: "Are you drinking?" asked the little prince upon finding the tippler surrounded by empty and full bottles.
paragraphs.zh: “你喝酒吗？”小王子发现那个酒鬼周围摆满了空瓶和满瓶，便问道。

paragraphs.en: "Yes, I am drinking," replied the tippler with a somber expression.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，我正在喝酒，”那个酗酒者一脸严肃地回答。

paragraphs.en: "Why do you drink?" inquired the little prince sympathetically.
paragraphs.zh: “你为什么喝酒？”小王子同情地问道。

paragraphs.en: "Forget what?" pressed the little prince, already feeling sorry for him.
paragraphs.zh: “忘了什么？”小王子追问了一句，已经为他感到有些难过。

paragraphs.en: "I am ashamed of drinking," confessed the tippler, lowering his head.
paragraphs.zh: “我为喝酒感到羞愧，”酒鬼低下了头承认道。

paragraphs.en: "Ashamed of what exactly?" insisted the little prince, wanting to help.
paragraphs.zh: “到底羞愧什么呢？”小王子坚持问道，显然想帮上忙。

paragraphs.en: The tippler remained silent, shutting himself off completely.
paragraphs.zh: 酗酒者沉默不语，把自己完全隔离了开来。

paragraphs.en: Puzzled, the little prince continued on his journey. "Grown-ups are indeed very strange," he mused aloud.
paragraphs.zh: 困惑不解的小王子继续前行。“大人们真是奇怪得很呢，”他不禁出声思考道。
